artifacts_owner_key_idx.name: artifacts_owner_key_idx
artifacts_owner_key_idx.where: "artifacts"."external_key" is not null and "artifacts"."state" not in ('purging', 'deleted')

comment_notices_counts.name: comment_notices_counts
comment_notices_counts.value: "comment_notices"."created" in (0, 1) and "comment_notices"."resolved" in (0, 1) and "comment_notices"."replies" between 0 and 200

owner_brands_logo.name: owner_brands_logo
owner_brands_logo.value: ("owner_brands"."logo_sha256" is null and "owner_brands"."logo_type" is null and "owner_brands"."logo_width" is null and "owner_brands"."logo_height" is null and "owner_brands"."logo_bytes" is null) or (length("owner_brands"."logo_sha256") = 64 and "owner_brands"."logo_type" in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp') and "owner_brands"."logo_width" > 0 and "owner_brands"."logo_height" > 0 and "owner_brands"."logo_bytes" between 1 and 100000)

share_links_password_complete.name: share_links_password_complete
share_links_password_complete.value: ("share_links"."password_hash" is null) = ("share_links"."password_salt" is null) and ("share_links"."password_hash" is null) = ("share_links"."password_iterations" is null)
